hypotheses.statement: Increasing swirl intensity analog s consistently improves stability.
hypotheses.note: Higher swirl shortens the mixing lag into an in-phase heat-release band, so a common 'more swirl is always more stable' rule fails.

hypotheses.statement: Unstable conditions form a single connected region in the explored domain.
hypotheses.note: The campaign did not isolate a disconnected pocket.
